title: Chicago Traffic Crashes, Vehicles, People, and Weather
description: A course-ready snapshot of Chicago police-reported traffic crashes from complete calendar years 2018 through 2025, with normalized vehicle and person tables and a one-row-per-crash NOAA weather analysis table.

coverage.note: Only complete calendar years are included. Later source amendments require a new immutable course release.

join_keys.design_note: The release supplies stable join handles but does not prejoin Census, ACS, neighborhood, roadway, transit, or other contextual attributes. Students choose and justify those enrichments.

sources.name: Local Climatological Data
sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

weather_method.reported_weather: The crash table preserves the categorical condition recorded by the reporting officer.
weather_method.numerical_weather: Each geocoded crash is assigned to the nearer of Chicago O'Hare and Chicago Midway airport. The nearest NOAA FM-15/FM-16 observation within 90 minutes is attached to the analysis table.
weather_method.time_basis: NOAA LCD timestamps use Local Standard Time without daylight saving time. Chicago crash wall-clock timestamps are converted to Central Standard Time before matching.
weather_method.caution: Airport observations are contextual measurements, not conditions measured at the exact crash location.

course_redactions: person home city, state, and ZIP
vehicle carrier, permit, and towing identifiers
privacy.assessment: The person table retains public categorical crash attributes such as age, sex, injury classification, safety equipment, and BAC result. It must not be treated as a roster of identifiable individuals.

license.city_of_chicago: See City of Chicago Data Portal Terms of Use; source and modifications must be identified.
license.noaa: United States government data; cite NOAA NCEI and the Local Climatological Data product.

artifacts.name: vehicles
artifacts.grain: One row per crash unit, normally a vehicle, pedestrian, or pedal cyclist

artifacts.name: people
artifacts.grain: One row per person represented in a crash report

artifacts.name: crash_analysis
artifacts.grain: One row per crash with time, geographic keys, and numerical weather
